d: Josh Giddey puts on a HISTORIC performance, finishing with 23 POINTS, 14 REBOUNDS and a career-high 22 ASSISTS! Giddey becomes just the second player in Chicago Bulls franchise history to record at least 20 points, 20 assists and 10 rebounds in a game, joining Guy Rodgers, who accomplished the feat in 1966. His 22 assists are tied for the second-most in a single game in Bulls history and are the most by any NBA player this season. Giddey also becomes the first player in the NBA this season to record a 20-point, 20-assist game.
